modules.name: Token-budget rules
modules.summary: Standing policy Claude follows: /clear on topic change, @file, Haiku subagents.

modules.name: /token-saver + /repo-skills skills
modules.summary: Two on-demand skills: the token audit, and repo-skills, which finds and links parked skills that fit the repo you are in.

modules.name: Session-start audit
modules.summary: Short budget line at session start. Warns if CLAUDE.md is fat or cache looks cold.

modules.name: Quiet bash rewriter
modules.summary: Rewrites git status/log and test commands to short reporters before they run.

modules.name: Trim huge bash output
modules.summary: Keeps head+tail of huge successful stdout. Never trims failures.

modules.name: Compact keep-list
modules.summary: Before /compact, remind Claude to keep errors, files touched, and next steps.

modules.name: Cache-bust guard
modules.summary: Asks before a mid-session model switch when the prompt cache is warm.

modules.name: Slimmer startup settings
modules.summary: Caps bash output at 8k chars and sets CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT=1 (reversible). Does not write enableArtifact:false, which cannot be turned back on.

modules.name: Cap extra thinking tokens
modules.summary: Sets MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=8000. Skip this if you want full reasoning on hard tasks.

modules.name: Disable claude.ai connectors
modules.summary: Stops Slack/Jira/etc connectors from loading every turn. Only if you do not use them.

modules.name: Disable remote control
modules.summary: Turns off remote-control tool definitions you are not using.

modules.name: Cache light in the CLI status line
modules.summary: CLI bar: cache warm/cold, hit %, recache-if-cold. VS Code panel already has a clock — skip if you only use the editor.

modules.name: Editable quiet-bash map
modules.summary: Installs ~/.claude/token-saver/quiet.json so you can add pnpm/cargo/kubectl rewrites. Never overwrites your edits.
